mapper.insert: INSERT INTO departments (id, parent_id, department_type, department_name, department_name_pinyin, department_name_pinyin_abbr, summary, description, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{parentId}, #{departmentType}, #{departmentName}, #{departmentNamePinyin}, #{departmentNamePinyinAbbr}, #{summary}, #{description}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE departments SET parent_id = #{parentId}, department_type = #{departmentType}, department_name = #{departmentName}, department_name_pinyin = #{departmentNamePinyin}, department_name_pinyin_abbr = #{departmentNamePinyinAbbr}, summary = #{summary}, description = #{description}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
